No predecessor PR is attributed. ## Merge readiness ⚠️ **Ready for maintainer review - 2 items remain** Keep open for normal maintainer merge handling. The final head fixes the prior truncation-order finding and now applies the shared transformation at the Gateway producer used by both single and batched session-title reads. **Priority:** P2 **Reviewed head:** `64e0766623a889987fb938da471ab8857b77bb01` ## Review scores | Measure | Result | What it means | |---|---|---| | **Overall readiness** | 🐚 platinum hermit **(4/6)** | The corrected owner-boundary patch has focused regression coverage and no remaining discrete correctness finding. | | **Proof confidence** | 🌊 off-meta tidepool | Not applicable: This is a maintainer-authored PR, so external-contributor proof gating does not apply; the PR body nevertheless provides before/after Gateway and sidebar evidence. | | **Patch quality** | 🐚 platinum hermit **(4/6)** | No actionable review findings were identified. | ## Verification | Check | Result | Evidence | |---|---|---| | **Real behavior** | Not applicable | Not applicable: This is a maintainer-authored PR, so external-contributor proof gating does not apply; the PR body nevertheless provides before/after Gateway and sidebar evidence. | | **Evidence reviewed** | 6 items | Owner-boundary repair: The final head flattens Markdown before the 240-character bound in the common projection, and the transcript title reader opts into that behavior only for the last-message preview.
Shared consumers: The Gateway sessions-list path copies the derived preview into response rows, while the sessions-list tool independently reads the same title fields; this is a producer-level fix rather than a Control UI-only workaround.
Prior blocker resolved: The diff from the prior reviewed head replaces truncation-before-flattening with flattening-before-truncation and adds a cap-crossing link regression test. | | **Findings** | None | None. | | **Security** | None | None. | ## How this fits together Gateway transcript readers derive `lastMessagePreview` for session-list responses, which feed the Control UI, TUI, native clients, and the agent session-list tool. The Control UI then selects the highest-priority status, digest, or preview for an idle session row. ```mermaid flowchart LR A[Session transcript] --> B[Gateway preview projection] B --> C[Session title reader] C --> D[Session list response] D --> E[Control UI sidebar] D --> F[TUI and native lists] D --> G[Agent session-list tool] E --> H[Idle row subtitle priority] ``` ## Before merge - [ ] **Resolve merge risk (P1)** - `lastMessagePreview` changes from raw Markdown to display prose for all session-list consumers; this is the intended contract, but integrations that treated it as raw transcript text will observe a content change. - [ ] **Complete next step (P2)** - The patch is technically ready for ordinary maintainer review, but the maintainer-authored/protected item must not enter automated cleanup.

Do we have a high-confidence way to reproduce the issue? Yes—source reproducible: current main passes the final transcript message through the shared projection without Markdown flattening, then exposes it through session-list fields consumed as display text. Yes—the Gateway producer is the narrowest shared owner, and the final head covers both cached single and batched paths.
